name: write_memory
description: Write a contiguous range of up to 512 finite values to a visible device with writable memory, as a chip's put instruction does (the devices read_memory lists; a Logic Memory has none: memory_not_writable). Refused before anything is written: a range past the memory's last address (invalid_argument), and an IC Housing or suit with no chip (no_programmable_chip).

reference_id.description: Memory-device reference ID returned by list_devices.
